mint.label: SolEVM devnet test token: 6 decimals, no value, not USDC

steps.title: Fund the administrator and transport verifier, who pay rent for the records they create

checks.what: on-chain outcome is success

steps.title: Create the labelled 6-decimal devnet test mint (not Circle USDC)

checks.what: on-chain outcome is success
mint has 6 decimals, the transport key as mint authority and no freeze authority

steps.title: Create custody, escrow, adapter vault and transport token accounts; mint test tokens to the transport

checks.what: on-chain outcome is success
custody is owned by the custody-authority PDA, empty, with no delegate or close authority
transport source holds the 5000000 minted base units

steps.title: Namespace claim co-signed by a key that is not the program's upgrade authority

checks.what: on-chain outcome is rejected: Unauthorized (6000)
every tracked leg account and token balance is byte-for-byte unchanged
remote config was not created

steps.title: Claim the namespace: initialize_remote_leg co-signed by the upgrade authority

checks.what: on-chain outcome is success
config binds administrator, guardian, verifier, mint, custody and escrow
config binds the domain and starts unfrozen at version 1

steps.title: Create the risk config and the strict-next inbound control lane

checks.what: on-chain outcome is success
control lane starts empty with a zero commitment

steps.title: Initialize the deterministic test strategy adapter bound to this namespace

checks.what: on-chain outcome is success

steps.title: Create the strategy config and the remote position

checks.what: on-chain outcome is success
strategy binds the adapter program, state and vault with the principal ceiling
position starts with every bucket at zero and no open transfer

steps.title: Create the outbound reporting lane

checks.what: on-chain outcome is success
outbound lane starts at sequence 1 with no reports

steps.title: Authenticated Allocate A (sequence 1) delivered by the transport verifier

checks.what: on-chain outcome is success
AllocateAccepted carries sequence 1, 1000000 authorized and the canonical message id
control lane at sequence 1 with commitment = keccak(domain, previous, message id)
transfer A is pending with 1000000 authorized at sequence 1
consumed-message record for sequence 1 exists
position holds A as the open allocation

steps.title: Replay of Allocate A's exact canonical bytes

checks.what: on-chain outcome is rejected: InvalidSequence (6036)
every tracked leg account and token balance is byte-for-byte unchanged

steps.title: Valid next Allocate signed by an attacker posing as the transport verifier

checks.what: on-chain outcome is rejected: Unauthorized (6000)
every tracked leg account and token balance is byte-for-byte unchanged
no transfer record exists for the forged allocation

steps.title: Bridge stand-in delivers allocation A's test tokens to custody

checks.what: on-chain outcome is success
custody balance rose by exactly 1000000
leg accounting is untouched until the leg itself observes the arrival

steps.title: Permissionless reconcile classifies the arrival as unattributed custody

checks.what: on-chain outcome is success
observed surplus and unattributed custody are both 1000000

steps.title: Attribute the arrival to allocation A, completing it

checks.what: on-chain outcome is success
custody equals attributed + recalled + unattributed
A is complete with 1000000 attributed and no unattributed custody left

steps.title: Publish RemoteReport epoch 1 on the outbound lane

checks.what: on-chain outcome is success
the published bytes decode canonically and re-encode to the same message id
report is sequence 1 and chains from the lane's previous commitment
lane commitment advanced to keccak(domain, previous, message id) and the next sequence by one
report states epoch 1 and remote principal 1000000
report record stores the type, message id and commitments

steps.title: Authenticated Allocate B (sequence 2)

checks.what: on-chain outcome is success
AllocateAccepted carries sequence 2, 1000000 authorized and the canonical message id
control lane at sequence 2 with commitment = keccak(domain, previous, message id)
transfer B is pending with 1000000 authorized at sequence 2
consumed-message record for sequence 2 exists

steps.title: Only part of allocation B arrives in custody

checks.what: on-chain outcome is success
custody balance rose by exactly 600000
leg accounting is untouched until the leg itself observes the arrival

steps.title: Attribute the partial arrival to allocation B

checks.what: on-chain outcome is success
custody equals attributed + recalled + unattributed
B stays pending with 600000 of 1000000 attributed

steps.title: Resolve(Close) of allocation B after a partial arrival

checks.what: on-chain outcome is success
Resolve consumed inbound sequence 3 on the shared control lane
TransportSettlement is published in the same instruction, chained on the outbound lane
settlement is Closed: claim 1000000, credited 600000, impaired 400000
ledger: claim 1000000 = credit 600000 + impaired 400000 + recovered 0
B is closed with only its arrival attributed, and no cycle is open

steps.title: The rest of B's assets arrive after the close

checks.what: on-chain outcome is success
custody balance rose by exactly 300000
leg accounting is untouched until the leg itself observes the arrival

steps.title: Resolve(Recover) credits the late arrival against the impairment pool

checks.what: on-chain outcome is success
Resolve consumed inbound sequence 4 on the shared control lane
TransportSettlement is published in the same instruction, chained on the outbound lane
settlement is Recovered: claim 400000, credited 300000, impaired 100000
no double count: B keeps its 600000, the recovery record holds the 300000

steps.title: Replay of the Recover message cannot credit the pool twice

checks.what: on-chain outcome is rejected: InvalidSequence (6036)
every tracked leg account and token balance is byte-for-byte unchanged

steps.title: Publish RemoteReport epoch 2 after the close and recovery

checks.what: on-chain outcome is success
the published bytes decode canonically and re-encode to the same message id
report is sequence 4 and chains from the lane's previous commitment
lane commitment advanced to keccak(domain, previous, message id) and the next sequence by one
report states epoch 2 and remote principal 1900000
report record stores the type, message id and commitments

steps.title: Authenticated Allocate C (sequence 5)

checks.what: on-chain outcome is success
AllocateAccepted carries sequence 5, 500000 authorized and the canonical message id
control lane at sequence 5 with commitment = keccak(domain, previous, message id)
transfer C is pending with 500000 authorized at sequence 5
consumed-message record for sequence 5 exists

steps.title: Emergency guardian freezes the leg

checks.what: on-chain outcome is success
leg is frozen and the event names the guardian

steps.title: Close of C on the frozen leg without the guardian

checks.what: on-chain outcome is rejected: Frozen (6002)
every tracked leg account and token balance is byte-for-byte unchanged

steps.title: Close of C on the frozen leg co-signed by an attacker posing as the guardian

checks.what: on-chain outcome is rejected: Unauthorized (6000)
every tracked leg account and token balance is byte-for-byte unchanged

steps.title: Guardian co-signed Close of C on the frozen leg (nothing arrived)

checks.what: on-chain outcome is success
Resolve consumed inbound sequence 6 on the shared control lane
TransportSettlement is published in the same instruction, chained on the outbound lane
guardian-cosigned Closed settlement: claim 500000, credited 0, impaired 600000
final ledger: claims 1500000 = credit 600000 + impaired 600000 + recovered 300000
C is closed and custody still equals attributed principal
